article_title: C# Specification 组合：AND、OR 与 NOT
core_theme: 把纯内存 Specification 和可被 EF Core 翻译的表达式 Specification 分开实现，并安全组合 AND、OR、NOT。
reader_takeaway: 知道何时使用委托、何时保留表达式树，能用参数重绑定和真值测试减少查询组合隐患。
summary_angle: 三个逻辑操作符背后有两个执行面：内存短路规则与数据库翻译边界需要同时可见。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Combining C# Specifications Starts With Two Predicate Models：纯规格以 bool IsSatisfiedBy 立即计算，表达式规格保存 Expression<Func<T,bool>> 供 LINQ provider 检查。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧同一条规则分成一条内存路径和一张表达式纸卷，最后在同一候选对象前汇合。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Complete Composition Implementation 与 Read the Expression Composition Step by Step：And、Or、Not 通过参数重绑定和 AndAlso、OrElse、Not 构造新表达式树。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中央复古规则机器把两根 candidate 参数线接到一个共享端口，再生成清晰的逻辑轨道。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 AND, OR, and NOT Truth Tables 与 What the Tests Prove：真值表、布尔恒等式、De Morgan 变换和 SQLite 关系提供程序测试共同检查行为。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 右侧测试灯箱展示四格真值表和一个 SQLite 数据库圆盘，作为验证终点。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Predicate Composition Is Not Query-Envelope Composition 与 Composition Guardrails：组合器只处理 Boolean criteria，排序、投影、分页、Include 等查询状态需要单独规则。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 最后一道边界门只允许 predicate 卡片通过，排序、分页、投影卡片停在边界外。

main_metaphor: 一台 1990 年代电视动画风格的规则实验机，展示同一谓词从内存路径到表达式树再到关系查询验证。
primary_subject: 中央发光的 Specification 组合机器
subject_action: 把两个 candidate 参数重接到一个共享端口，并将 AND、OR、NOT 规则送入可验证的查询轨道。
composition: 水平左到右单点聚焦，左侧输入，中间规则机器，右侧测试和边界出口。
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: 1990s retro animation look, cel-shaded color, analog grain, bold simple backgrounds, nostalgic broadcast texture
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中；规则组合适合用清晰的复古动画机器和分支动作表达。
style_safety_note: 使用泛化的 1990 年代复古动画质感，不指向具体作品、品牌、工作室或艺术家。
avoid: 伪造 SQL、坐标轴或指标
过多装饰和难以辨认的文字
reference_strategy: 纯文本生成，不使用原文图片；画面只借用文章中的双执行面、参数重绑定、真值测试和谓词边界。
draft_goal: 第一轮验证中央规则机器是否清楚、两条执行路径是否能读懂，以及复古动画质感是否仍保持技术信息的可辨认性。
revision_targets: 如果双路径不清楚，强化左侧内存路径与表达式纸卷的分流
如果画面像仪表盘，删除小面板并保留中央机器与右侧验证出口
如果文字变形，只保留 C#、AND、OR、NOT
final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a polished editorial technical illustration about combining C# specifications with AND, OR, and NOT. Theme: the same business predicate has two execution surfaces, a pure in-memory delegate and a provider-bound expression tree, and both need a clear composition boundary. Summary angle: make the short-circuit logic, parameter rebinding, truth-table verification, and predicate-only boundary readable in one wide scene. Information blocks: a C# rule enters from the left and splits into an in-memory path and an expression-tree parchment; a central retro rule machine reconnects two candidate parameters into one shared port and emits AND, OR, and NOT branches; a small four-row truth-table lightbox and SQLite verification disk mark the test boundary; a final gate admits predicate criteria while ordering, projection, and paging cards remain outside. Main metaphor: a retro animation-era rule laboratory machine. Subject: one glowing Specification composition machine. Subject action: reconnect two candidate parameters to one shared port and send AND, OR, and NOT rules through a verifiable query track. Composition/framing: horizontal left-to-right storytelling, one dominant central focal subject, 2-4 supporting narrative beats, input on the left, split execution paths around the machine, verification on the right, generous negative space, wide 2.35:1 frame. Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with 1990s retro animation look, cel-shaded color, analog grain, bold simple backgrounds, nostalgic broadcast texture. Polished, readable, lightly playful, with clear engineering forms; do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: deep indigo, cream white, coral red, teal green, restrained amber highlights. Visible text policy: allow only the short marks C#, AND, OR, and NOT if rendered cleanly; no poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake SQL, no fake chart axes, no fake metrics. Constraints and avoid: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fabricated database output, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter, no pixelated unreadable labels.
